opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as you are studying or working in the UK, or the course you wish to attend is being held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become Society members. Others should be a Society member for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,200 to enable members to attend formal short training courses or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as you are studying or working in the UK, or you intend to carry out your fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become Society members; others should be a Society member for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £2,000 to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with a field‑based genetic research project, with the expectation that results are suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering eligible travel and materials costs (UK‑based, economy class).

opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

deadlines.raw: 1st February, April, June, August, October, December

amount.raw: up to £200 (Scheme A); up to £500 (Scheme B); up to £750 (co‑sponsored); up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of their PhD viva (Scheme A). Scheme B and C are open to PhD students and postdocs within six years of their PhD viva. Applicants must be UK‑based for travel outside the UK or non‑UK‑based for UK conferences.
opportunities.summary: Grants to support attendance at genetics‑related conferences, covering travel, accommodation and registration costs, with different streams for Society meetings, non‑Society meetings and virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Carer’s Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member, regardless of the age of the person they are caring for.
opportunities.summary: Award of up to £60 per day to support attendance at Society meetings for members with caring responsibilities.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: several hundred pounds up to about £2,000 (major sponsorship levels between £1,000 and £2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society can apply at any time; applications should be submitted at least three months before the event.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship for genetics‑themed meetings not organised directly by the Society, with possible funding levels from a few hundred pounds up to several thousand pounds.
